hints.title: Unpivoting Columns to Rows
hints.text: Transform each store column into separate rows containing the store name and corresponding price.

hints.title: Filtering Unavailable Products
hints.text: Filter out entries where the store price is null to exclude stores that do not stock the product.

hints.title: Combining Results with UNION ALL
hints.text: Use union all across queries for store1, store2, and store3 to retain all valid rows without redundant deduplication.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT product_id, 'store1' AS store, store1 AS price
FROM Products
WHERE store1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT product_id, 'store2' AS store, store2 AS price
FROM Products
WHERE store2 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT product_id, 'store3' AS store, store3 AS price
FROM Products
WHERE store3 IS NOT NULL;
```

complexity.time: O(N) three linear scans concatenated together
complexity.notes: Unpivot of wide product table into tall relational schema.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without unpivoting, down-stream relational queries require hardcoding multiple store columns.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: UNION ALL avoids sorting overhead required by standard UNION.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize unpivoting via UNION ALL and filter null values.
